description: This file implements the ContinueWatching plugin for a Thunder-based media platform, providing APIs to manage application tokens for 'Continue Watching' functionality. It includes encryption/decryption, JSON handling, and platform-specific feature checks.

classes.name: ContinueWatching
classes.description: Main plugin class providing JSON-RPC methods for token management and versioning.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Base class for platform-specific continue watching implementation including encryption/decryption and JSON storage.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImplFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create specific implementations based on application name.

classes.name: NetflixContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ContinueWatchingImpl for Netflix, handling encryption, hashing, and token encoding/decoding.

methods.name: getApplicationToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored token for a given application.

methods.name: setApplicationToken
methods.description: Stores or updates the token for a specified application.

methods.name: deleteApplicationToken
methods.description: Deletes the stored token for a specified application.

methods.name: getAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the application token string.

methods.name: setAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to save the application token string.

methods.name: deleteAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to delete the application token from storage.

methods.name: encryptData
methods.description: Encrypts data using platform-specific security APIs.

methods.name: decryptData
methods.description: Decrypts data using platform-specific security APIs.

methods.name: writeToJson
methods.description: Stores encrypted token data into a JSON file.

methods.name: readFromJson
methods.description: Reads encrypted token data from JSON storage.

methods.name: deleteToken
methods.description: Removes the token entry from storage.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Generates sha256 hash of a string.

methods.name: checkTR181
methods.description: Checks feature enablement via RFC parameter.

methods.name: tr181FeatureEnabled
methods.description: Determines if feature is enabled via platform/configuration checks.

methods.name: createContinueWatchingImpl
methods.description: Factory method creating platform-specific ContinueWatching implementation.
